items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Lawrence Welk only in the interviewer's question ('He's been writing for Lawrence Welk and what not') and does not respond with any personal interaction, relationship, or specific knowledge about Welk himself.

ctx.x: He's a genius, you know that.
He's been writing for Lawrence Welk and what not.
Hey, you know who we didn't mention - Old Gal - Jimmy Crawford.
